name: Yayoi Sakura no Sora ni Warae!
source:
It's the morning of the university entrance exam. Yuu Katase is entrusted with returning an admission ticket lost by a girl named Ritsuko Ishikawa.

When Yuu and Ritsuko meet... will the cherry blossoms bloom or will they fall?

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/2902]Freem[/url]]
translation:
这是高考的早上。片濑优受托归还女孩石川律子丢失的入场券。

当优和律子相遇时……樱花会盛开还是会落下？

[来自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/2902]Freem[/url]]
